title: COMNAVRESFOR NOTICE 1001

COMNA VRESFORNOTE 1001
NOO
16 Nov 2026
Subj: LAPSE OF APPROPRIATIONS PLANNING CHECKLIST
Ref: (a) Contingency Plan Guidance for Continuation of Operations in the Absence of
Available Appropriations, January 2027
Encl: (1) Lapse of Appropriations Planning Checklist
1. Purpose. To provide guidance and procedures per reference (a) and utilizing enclosure (1) to
Commander, Navy Reserve Force (COMNA VRESFOR) in preparation for a potential lapse of
appropriations.
2. Cancellation. September 2027
3. Applicability. This notice is inherently an echelon 2 function and applies to all equities
assigned to COMNA VRESFOR.
4. Background. The objective of this notice is to codify the Navy Reserve Force's planning
effort in the event of a lapse of appropriations, commonly referred to as a "government
shutdown". Action items in enclosure (1) were developed as a result of the lessons learned
collected by COMNA VRESFOR following the lapse of appropriations at the start of Fiscal Year
2026. This is a "living" document, and the checklist items will continue to be fine-tuned at the
conclusion of future potential shutdowns. "D-XX" indicates days prior to an anticipated
government shutdown, with funding projected to lapse at the end of "D-Day" in the absence of
Congressional action. "D+ 1" represents the next business day following a lapse of
appropriations.
5. Action. Execute enclosure (1) per specified timelines. Responsible Offices will sign and date
an official copy of enclosure ( 1 ). The official copy of enclosure ( 1) will be maintained by the
Commander, Navy Reserve Forces Command (COMNA VRESFORCOM) Chief of Staff. If a
checklist item cannot be completed by proposed date (i.e. D - 21) due to lack of information,
third party action or approval, or any other reason, the responsible office remains accountable for
completion of the item as soon as possible, and must revisit periodically at intervals either
specified by the third party that must first take action to enable completion of the item, or every
24 hours if a timeline for resolution is not specified.
6. Records Management. Records created as a result of this notice, regardless of media and
format, must be managed per Secretary of the Navy Manual 5210.1 of September 2019.
